messages:
Nina Alvarez: Heads-up team 1: we need a short migration note and updated SDK snippets for the v1->v2 model-id change. I opened a tracking PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2610

Caleb Morris: Can do JS + Ruby. Quick question2 should we show the alias mapping example? some customers relied on rw-legacy aliases.

Nina Alvarez: Yes show a tiny alias map example (1 line) and link to the full model-aliases guide. Keep main snippets focused on v2 usage.

Rina Sato: I'll add an embeddings note 1 explaining vector dim changes and a short command to reindex. Also will add a checklist to PR for redirects so we don't break deep links.

docs-ci: build passed for branch feature/migrate-model-ids (job #1278).

Caleb Morris: Draft JS snippet (v2):
```
// JS v2 minimal
await fetch('https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwft/gpt-3x', prompt: 'Summarize:' })
})
```
Collapsed legacy note: `// v1 used model id rw-legacy/* or header X-Redwood-SDK-Version: 1`

Rina Sato: Embedding reindex example (CLI): `./scripts/reindex-embeddings --collection users --recreate-schema`

Nina Alvarez: l10n: en, fr, de, ja, es. l10n-bot please queue strings when PR is ready. We need translations before banner goes live.

l10n-bot: watching PR 2610; will create translation job on /strings-ready. Please include translator notes for the embedding checklist.

Caleb Morris: One more: add an FAQ bullet: "Will keys keep working?" Answer: yes, keys remain valid; v1-specific behaviors will be deprecated on schedule.

Rina Sato: Added redirect checklist to PR and a smoke-test entry: `scripts/docs-smoke.sh --check-redirects`.

Nina Alvarez: Final actions: Caleb push JS/Ruby snippets, Rina finalize embeddings paragraph and reindex command, I'll merge once l10n job created and CI green. We'll announce in #announcements on deploy. :thumbsup:
